Based on my exploration of qlang, here are the queries for each task:

K1: `["Apple","banana","APPLE","Cherry","banana","date","Date","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | count`

K2: `filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) | * (* /total | * (coalesce 0) | sum)`

K3: `lines | * (split " " | /1) | groupBy ~(keyword) | * count`

K4: `[/dependencies, /devDependencies] | union | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys | * (json | parseJson)`

K5: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments !| (0)) /id]) | reverse | take 3 | * /id`

K6: `lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~((/2 | lower | eq "de")) | filter ~((/1 | ne "")) | * /1 | * parseJson | sum | div 3 | round 1`

K7: `/services | * {:name (keyword | json | parseJson) :port /port} | filter ~(/port | type | eq ::number) | sort ~(/port) | * ~([/name ":" (/port | json | parseJson)] | join)`

K8: `/results | filter ~((/email | ne null) & (/email | lower | contains "example.com")) | filter ~(/user | has :name) | * ~((/user/name/last + ", " + /user/name/first) | join)`

K9: `filter ~((/user | ne null) & (/action | lower | eq "login")) | * (/user | lower) | distinct | sort`

K10: `groupBy ~(/dept) | * (filter ~(/salary | ne null) | * /salary | sum | div (count))`

K11: `/tags | * (split "," | * (trim | lower) | filter ~(ne "") | .) | flat | groupBy ~(keyword) | sort | reverse | first 3 | keys | * (json | parseJson)`

K12: `--raw lines | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(ne "") | * (split "|" | {:qty (/1 | parseJson) :price (/2 | parseJson)} | /qty | mul /price) | sum | round 2`

K13: `filter ~((/env | lower | eq "prod")) | every ~(/replicas | coalesce 1 | gte 2)`

K14: `/items | sum | gte 1 | filter ~(.)`

K8: `/results | filter ~((/email | ne null)) | filter ~((/email | lower | contains "example.com")) | filter ~((/user | type | ne ::null)) | filter ~((/user/name/last | type | ne ::null)) | * ~((/user/name/last + ", " + /user/name/first))`
